csv_project_name: A/E Service for Wilderness Gateway State Trail - Initial Dev
csv_scope_of_work: Project is for the initial development of three (3) new access areas for the Wilderness Gateway State Trail. Each access area will include gravel parking lots for approximately 70 vehicles, entry drives, two (2) canoe launches, and three (3) vault toilets. The three (3) access areas are located in Catawba County, NC and each will act as a future trailhead. Conceptual maps are attached for general reference.
